Article 8.4: Wallet, Rewards Credits and Payout Credits

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule
Your Wallet

Your wallet holds rewards credits and payout credits.

Rewards Credits
You earn rewards credits of 1% of every purchase, and 5% on Nexus Connect account purchases.
Rewards credits can be used on purchases.
Rewards credits are not withdrawable.
Payout Credits
Approved payouts can be credited to your wallet as payout credits.
Payout credits are withdrawable. To withdraw payout credits, submit a withdrawal request from the Wallet page in your dashboard.
Paying with Wallet Credits
Purchases paid with wallet credits get an extra 20% off, on top of any active promotion, unless the promotion states otherwise.
When you pay with wallet credits, your rewards credits are used first.
